Save a plot at its final journal size and run pre-flight checks

Source: R/export.R
save_olinkviz.Rd

Exports a ggplot, patchwork, or pheatmap object at an exact physical size in one or more formats (`"pdf"`, `"png"`, `"tiff"`, `"eps"`, `"svg"`, `"jpeg"`). PDFs and EPS use the Cairo device when available so fonts are embedded; TIFFs use LZW compression. `width` accepts numeric values in `units` or journal column keywords (`"single"`, `"1.5"`, `"double"`), and `height` accepts numeric values or `"max"` (see [journal_width()] and [journal_height()]).

Usage

save_olinkviz(
  plot,
  file,
  width = 89,
  height = 70,
  units = "mm",
  formats = c("pdf", "png"),
  dpi = 300,
  journal = getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature"),
  check = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A `ggplot`, `patchwork`, `pheatmap`, or `gtable`/`grob` object.

file

Output path. A file extension is ignored; one file per entry of `formats` is written next to it.

width

Width in `units`, or a width keyword (`"single"`, `"1.5"`, `"double"`, `"full"`, `"1col"`, `"2col"`, `"3col"`). Default `89`.

height

Height in `units`, or `"max"` for the journal's maximum height. Default `70`.

units

`"mm"` (default), `"cm"` or `"in"`.

formats

Any of `"pdf"`, `"png"`, `"svg"`, `"tiff"`, `"eps"`, `"jpeg"`. Default `c("pdf", "png")`.

dpi

Resolution of raster formats (default 300).

journal

Registered journal id (see [journal_specs()]) used to resolve width keywords and pre-flight check limits. Defaults to `getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature")`.

check

`TRUE`, `FALSE` (default), or a character vector of checks to run: any of `"fit"`, `"size"`, `"text"`, `"lines"`, `"colour"`.

...

Additional arguments passed to [ggplot2::ggsave()].

Value

Invisibly, the paths of the files written.

Details

With `check = TRUE`, the figure is audited against `journal` before saving via [olinkviz_check_size()], [olinkviz_check_fit()], [olinkviz_check_text()], and [olinkviz_check_lines()]. Findings are reported as warnings or messages that never block the export.

See also

Other export: labs_panel(), olinkviz_combine()

Examples

# \donttest{
old <- olinkviz_options(base_size = 7, axes = "l")
p <- plot_boxplot(probc, assay = "IL6", group = "Project")
save_olinkviz(p, file.path(tempdir(), "il6_boxplot"), width = 89, height = 70)
save_olinkviz(p, file.path(tempdir(), "il6_nature"), width = "single", height = 70,
              journal = "nature", check = TRUE)
#> olinkviz_check_text(): 1 text item(s) are above the 7 pt maximum the nature guide states: plot title 9 pt (x1). (Shown once per session; olinkviz_check_text() or olinkviz_preflight() show it on demand.)
options(old)
# }
